definitions.gloss: to be mixed together; to mingle; to intermingle
definitions.explanation: Describes a state where different elements are blended or mingled together, whether physical things, people, emotions, or abstract concepts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入|い}り{混|ま}じる。
⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入|い}り{混|ま}じって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese and foreigners were mingled together at the venue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入|い}り{混|ま}じった⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧な{気持|きも}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新生活|しんせいかつ}→新生活：19028_shinseikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started my new life with mixed feelings of expectation and anxiety.

notes:
An intransitive verb. Often used with て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ to describe an ongoing mixed state. Frequently describes mixed emotions (〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入|い}り{混|ま}じった{気持|きも}ち) or mixed groups of people.

Also written as {入|い}り{交|ま}じる. The variant {交|ま}じる alone means to mix, while the {入|い}り- prefix emphasizes thorough mingling.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入|い}り{混|ま}じる — A and B intermingle
- {入|い}り{混|ま}じった⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧ — mixed emotions
- さまざまな〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入|い}り{混|ま}じる — various ~ are mixed together
